Name: Wireless Digital Storage
Author: bcxanth77
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Bringing Stardew Valley into the information age. Tired of building a chest monster to make even Minecraft players weep? Sick of having to build a shed just to hide all of your chests inside of the Shame Shed? Well welcome to the the future!

Maru has been hard at work in her spare time, and if you get to know her better she just might share her secret schematics. Build and place the Storage Terminal. Build some Storage Modules to increase the storage capacity of the terminal. And when you're ready, craft the Wireless Storage Interface to access your cloud storage from anywhere.[/color][/size]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Unlocking requires 2+ hearts with Maru. New saves will receive a letter with the schematics the day after reaching 2 hearts. Existing saves already at 2+ hearts will get the schematics one of two ways. If you are NOT married to Maru, you will immediately get a letter from her the first morning after logging in. If you ARE married to Maru, then she will give you the schematics the first time you talk to her.[/color][/size]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]The Storage Terminal can be placed anywhere a vanilla chest can be placed. You can craft multiple terminals, and they will all connect to the same cloud storage. (Think of it like an ender chest for Minecraft players). [/color][/size]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Using a configurable keyboard shortcut (Default: B) you can open the storage anywhere, as long as you have the wireless Access Interface equipped.The terminal itself can be broken and moved like vanilla if empty, or picked up and moved if full using a configurable hot key (Default: Left-Control+Left-Click).[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Manual:[/color][/size]
[list=1]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Unzip the mod folder into [/color][b][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Stardew Valley/Mods[/color][/size][/b][/size][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Run the game using SMAPI[/size][/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Mod Launcher:[/size][/color]
[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Install using Mod Manager[/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Launch the game through the Mod Manager or SMAPI[/size][/color][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Craft a Storage Terminal, with a starting storage capacity of 72 slots[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Expand your storage infinitely by crafting Storage Modules that increase the capacity an additional 36 slots per module[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Sort inventory by item name, stack size, or quality[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Filter by item type or text search[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Craft a Wireless Storage interface that you can equip in a new equipment slot next to the hat. Use the configurable hot key (Default: B) to access your terminal anywhere when equipped[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Craft multiple terminals and place them anywhere a chest can be placed, and they will all connect to the same cloud storage[/color][/size][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Use a configurable hot key (Default: Left-Ctrl+Left-Shift) to pick up the terminal, keeping the contents intact, and moving it to place in a new location[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Access the Shipping Bin from the Terminal screen, either directly from the Terminal or using the Wireless Interface[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]Configuration Options (GMCM Compatible):[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]Carry terminal key -  Default: Left-Ctrl+Left-Shift[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]Show sort buttons - Default: On[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]Wireless interface key - Default: B[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]Allow wireless access in caves: Default: On[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]Allow shipping bin access: Default: On[/color]

[b][size=4]Change Log[/size][/b]
[u][b][u][u]Ver 1.1.1[/u]
[/u][/b][/u]
[list]
[*]Bug fix for duplication bug related to right-click removal of items when in filtered view. Thanks to user 2391909645for the bug report![/*]
[*]Fixed a compatibility issue with the Lookup Anything mod that was preventing it from working within the terminal UI.[/*]
[/list]
[u][b][u]Ver 1.1[/u]
[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]Search bar in the terminal window — type to filter your stored items by name (full or partial). Right-click the box or use the × button to clear it.[/*]
[*]Category filters — a row of buttons (each an in-game item icon) that narrow the view to a single item category, plus a ? button for anything that doesn't fit the listed categories (e.g. modded items). Click an active button again to clear it.[/*]
[*]Text search and category work together.[/*]
[*]Amount sort — The middle sort button has been chanted from stack size, to item total count. Ranks items by their total quantity across all stacks (grouped per item and quality), so large stockpiles surface together, but only for the same quality.[/*]
[*]Maru dialogue — if you're already married to Maru, she now hands over the schematics in person with a spoken line. And once you've unlocked and placed a terminal, she'll check in once to ask how you like it.[/*]
[/list][size=3][u][b]Ver 1.0:[/b][/u][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Initial release[/size][/*]
[/list]


[color=#D4D4D8][size=4][b]Planned Changes[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3][b][u]Ver 1.2:[/u][/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Additional config options for Hard Mode[/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Config to allow for using the Wireless Interface from an inventory slot, instead of an equipment slot[/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Wireless crafting[/size][/color][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Stardew 1.6+[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]SMAPI 4.5.2+[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Content Patcher 2.9.1+[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM) 1.16.0+ (Optional)[/color][/size]

[color=#D4D4D8][b][size=4]Conflicts[/size][/b][/color]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]In its current form, any mod that adjusts the layout of the equipment slots, or adds additional equipment slots, will cause issues with displaying the equipment slot for the wireless interface. I'm working on a solution for this.[/color][/*]
[/list][list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Chests Anywhere, or any other mod that overrides custom UI for chests. Chests anywhere will technically still work, but it forces the Vanilla UI, which can cause some inventory slots to not display properly, or if the Terminal inventory gets too big the vanilla UI could become unusable. As far as I'm aware there's nothing I can do to prevent this.[/color][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Special thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/1552317]Pathoschild[/url] and the great Chests Anywhere mod for the inspiration.[/color]
